REQUEST: Ananya Iyer (SRE on-call), tenant acme, environment production, service cart-api, as of 2026-09-22T10:30:00Z

CLAIM (procedure): For cart-api latency after a deploy, turn on pool autotuning with the flag cart.redis_pool_autotune=on in the flag service; no approval is needed.

QUOTES: E1: "Turn on pool autotuning with the flag cart.redis_pool_autotune=on in the flag service; no approval is needed."

CITED EVIDENCE:
[E1] RB-CART-003 v3 · Remediation · runbook of record · owner cart-team · active since 2026-09-22 · fetched from the source (newer than the index)
admissible for this request: yes
cart-api latency after a deploy is usually the Redis client pool. Turn on pool autotuning with the flag cart.redis_pool_autotune=on in the flag service; no approval is needed. Roll the release back through the pipeline only if p95 is still above SLO 10 minutes after the flag change.
